description: Zero-dependency TypeScript library that truncates text to a UTF-8 byte budget and a line budget without splitting characters. Supports head, tail, and head-tail modes plus budgeted truncation markers.
rules: Call truncate(text, { maxBytes, maxLines }) with at least one finite budget; truncate(text) and truncate(text, {}) throw a TypeError.
Read result.text, not the return value itself: truncate returns a TruncateResult object with text, truncated, markerOmitted, and byte/line counts.
The marker counts against both budgets and is dropped when it cannot fit; pass marker: "" for plain content with no marker.
Use mode: "tail" or "head-tail" when the end of the output matters, such as stack traces; "head" is the default.
omittedBytes excludes the truncation marker; with a marker, keptBytes minus utf8ByteLength(marker) plus omittedBytes equals originalBytes.
truncate never splits a UTF-8 code point but does not protect grapheme clusters, and it treats ANSI escape sequences as ordinary text; strip ANSI codes before truncating terminal output.
